# appgatesdp_secret (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the object.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret string to store in Controller. Omit the field to keep the old password when updating a user.

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
